payment.a: Pay in the app with MTN MoMo, Orange Money or your HandyMan wallet. Your money is held safely and only released to the pro when the job is finished.

cities.a: Douala, Buea and Yaoundé, and more than 120 towns and cities across Cameroon.

price.a: Describe the job and add photos, and you get a clear price before you book. For larger projects, request a quote and we prepare one for you.

satisfaction.a: Your payment stays held until the work is done, and the job only closes when you share your completion code. Refunds go back to your HandyMan wallet. Our support team is available every day from 07:00 to 21:00 (WAT).

vetting.a: Our team checks every pro’s identity, documents and skills before they can take jobs on HandyMan.

tracking.a: Yes. Follow your pro on a live map and see each stage, from setting off to finished, with photos of the work.

pros.q: How do I become a pro?
pros.a: Download the same app and choose “I offer services” when you sign up. Add your skills, rates and service area, get verified, then receive nearby requests.

business.a: Yes. “My organisation” accounts let your team book together, and we handle signage, events and office projects. Request a business quote to get started.

aboutPage.lead: HandyMan Do IT is a Cameroonian company for interiors, furniture, signage and events. After {years}+ years of projects, we built the app so every job gets the same care.

story.title: Our story
body: We started as a design and craft company: interior and exterior design, upholstery and furniture, repairs, signage and event set-up. We work with families, SMEs and organisations, from the media to private businesses.

The HandyMan Do IT app brings that standard to every booking: verified pros, a clear price before anything starts, payment held until the job is done, and live tracking. It serves more than {towns} towns and cities across Cameroon.
